display.purpose: Page and section titles (h1-h3, .card-title). Sentence case, size+weight hierarchy, never uppercase.

body.purpose: Running copy, 14px base, IBM Plex Sans.

label.purpose: Small uppercase tracked labels (.label, .kpi-label, .section-title, .sidebar-group) — the one place uppercase survives.

numeral.purpose: Every money figure and count (.num, .tabular, .kpi-value) — Archivo at 112% font-stretch, tabular-nums.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Resting state for inputs and buttons before interaction.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Default lift for a card, KPI tile, or primary button.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: A hovered/lifted element, or a card that owns attention.

shadows.name: glass
shadows.purpose: A modal, dropdown, popover, or the command palette — paired with backdrop-blur and a translucent fill.

shadows.name: sidebar-edge
shadows.purpose: Separates the sidebar's trailing edge from the canvas without a hard border.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Hover/press state changes: color, shadow, and the 1px lift on primary/gold buttons.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Below this, the sidebar collapses to a hamburger-triggered glass overlay drawer.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default call-to-action. Ink fill at rest, lifts and turns gold on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; background-color: #0F0F12; color: #F2F2F4; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,15,18,0.04), 0 6px 16px -4px rgba(15,15,18,0.10); transition: all 150ms ease; border: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #FFC20E; color: #0F0F12; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(15,15,18,0.06), 0 16px 36px -8px rgba(15,15,18,0.16); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15,15,18,0.05); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Apple's "plain" button: no chrome at rest, a soft tint on touch.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; background-color: transparent; color: #0F0F12; border: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: rgba(15,15,18,0.06); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background-color: rgba(15,15,18,0.10); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The base container for one object meant to be read whole. Shadow carries the lift; a hairline keeps the edge crisp.
components.html:
Cash on hand

₹0
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 22px; border: 1px solid #e7e7eb; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,15,18,0.04), 0 6px 16px -4px rgba(15,15,18,0.10); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e7e7eb; padding: 14px 20px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #0F0F12; margin: 0; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; }

components.name: KPI Tile
components.description: A metric tile wearing a tinted status chip (icon in a tinted circle) instead of the retired colored rail.
components.html:
Runway

Not burning
components.css: .ds-kpi { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid #e7e7eb; background: #ffffff; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,15,18,0.04), 0 6px 16px -4px rgba(15,15,18,0.10); } .ds-kpi-status { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-kpi-status--good { background: rgba(26,122,76,0.1); color: #1a7a4c; } .ds-kpi-label { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #6b6b74; margin: 0; } .ds-kpi-value { margin-top: 6px; font-family: Archivo, monospace; font-size: 25px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; color: #0F0F12; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Input
components.description: A text field: soft shadow at rest, a firmer border and shadow plus an accent ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid #d7d7dd; background: #ffffff; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 13px; color: #0F0F12; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15,15,18,0.05); transition: box-shadow 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b6b74; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #6b6b74; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,15,18,0.04), 0 6px 16px -4px rgba(15,15,18,0.10), 0 0 0 2px rgba(15,15,18,0.10); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A pill-shaped status/severity label, tone-tinted at low fill opacity.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-chip--watch { background: rgba(181,87,12,0.1); color: #b5570c; border: 1px solid rgba(181,87,12,0.4); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: A navigation row on the vibrancy-material sidebar; the active item is a full gold pill, no rail.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 13.3px; font-weight: 600; color: #c9c9ce; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-sidebar-link:hover { background: #232326; color: #ffffff; } .ds-sidebar-link--active { background: #FFC20E; color: #0F0F12; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(255,194,14,0.25); }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Floating chrome over real content: modal, dropdown, command palette, mobile nav drawer. Translucent fill + backdrop-blur + a floating shadow.
components.css: .ds-glass { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(15,15,18,0.10), 0 28px 60px -12px rgba(15,15,18,0.28); border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px; }

narrative.overview: KaiERP replaced a deliberately flat, border-only-hierarchy system (three border weights carrying everything a shadow would normally carry) with a fluent, Apple-esque, minimalist depth language, taken as the canon/standing-exit path rather than an invented world: Apple's own system apps and macOS vibrancy fused with Notion/Craft's calm, content-first card minimalism. The paper ground, ink text scale, and the three-division/status categorical palettes are unchanged from the incumbent system, so the shift is structural, not a repaint: hierarchy now comes from a resting/raised/floating elevation ladder of real, soft, dual-layer shadows, and glass is reserved for chrome that genuinely floats over content.
keyCharacteristics: Elevation (shadow), not border weight, carries hierarchy.
Glass/vibrancy is functional (a floating surface with real content behind it), never decorative.
Headings are sentence-case, size+weight; small-caps tracked labels are reserved for grouped-list labels.
The three-division and five-status colors are categorical data encodings and are never restyled for aesthetic reasons.
One consistent-stroke icon system (lucide-react) — no Unicode dingbats standing in for icons.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold never carries body text — it fails contrast on paper — so a readable gold is always accent-soft (#8a6a00), never the raw hex.

rules.name: The Functional Color Floor
rules.body: Band and division colors are data encodings, set once and validated for contrast/CVD-safety. No visual-world change may retint, lighten, darken, or reassign them.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Heading Rule
rules.body: h1/h2/h3 and .card-title are never uppercase. Uppercase tracking is reserved for .label/.kpi-label/.section-title/.sidebar-group — never a page or card's own title.

rules.name: The Functional Glass Rule
rules.body: Translucency + backdrop-blur is reserved for chrome with real content behind it to blur. It is never applied to a static panel purely for a frosted look.

rules.name: The No-Colored-Rail Rule
rules.body: A left-border or top-border color stripe is retired. Status now reads through a tinted icon chip or a chip's own fill/border color.

dos: Do use a shadow token (soft/raised/floating/glass) for every new elevated surface — never a border-weight step to signal "this is raised."
Do reserve .glass/backdrop-blur for chrome that floats over real content (modals, dropdowns, popovers, the mobile nav drawer).
Do keep headings sentence-case; reserve uppercase tracking for grouped-list-style labels.
Do use lucide-react (or an equivalent real icon library) at one consistent stroke weight for any new icon; never a Unicode glyph or emoji.
Do keep every money or count value in tabular numerals.
donts: Don't restyle, retint, or reassign the band (status) or division colors for aesthetic reasons.
Don't apply backdrop-blur/translucency to a static, non-floating panel.
Don't reintroduce a colored border-left/top rail as a status indicator.
Don't revert to the pre-redesign 1.5-3px border ladder for hierarchy.
